narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Thirty two is the biggest number, so its circle is the biggest.
<bookmark mark='tile'/>Four is a multiple of four, but it is not a multiple of thirty two.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The circle for thirty two must leave four outside, so it cannot hold everything.

narration: <bookmark mark='check'/>To check, pick a number from each ring and test which multiples it is.
<bookmark mark='rule'/>A circle sits inside another when all its numbers belong to the bigger set.
